whyMatters.en: Queens, NYC punk band formed in 1974. Short songs, few chords, and Johnny Ramone’s downstroke guitar on early Sire albums set a clear US punk timing reference.
whyMatters.zh: 纽约皇后区朋克乐队，1974 年成立。短歌、少和弦，以及 Johnny Ramone 在早期 Sire 专辑上的下行扫弦，构成清楚的美国朋克时值参照。

note.en: 1-2-3-4 count-in; downstroke guitar; under three minutes.
note.zh: 1-2-3-4 起拍；下行扫弦吉他；不到三分钟。

note.en: From Rocket to Russia; pop melody at high punk tempo.
note.zh: 出自《Rocket to Russia》；高朋克速度下的流行旋律。

note.en: Marky-era Road to Ruin; still short-song form.
note.zh: Marky 时期《Road to Ruin》；仍是短歌形式。

interviewQuotes.text: I don't play leads. I don't want to play leads.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Johnny Ramone

shortBio.en: Queens punk, 1974–96. Joey, Johnny, Dee Dee; Tommy then Marky on drums. Blitzkrieg Bop is the core timing reference.
shortBio.zh: 皇后区朋克，1974–96。Joey、Johnny、Dee Dee；鼓手先后为 Tommy 与 Marky。《Blitzkrieg Bop》是主要时值参照。

body.en:
Ramones formed in Queens, New York, in 1974. Early Sire albums—Ramones, Leave Home, Rocket to Russia—fix Joey Ramone’s deadpan vocal, Johnny Ramone’s strict downstrokes, Dee Dee Ramone’s bass count-ins, and a leather-jacket stage look.

Blitzkrieg Bop (1976) is the clearest entry track. Influence shows in short songs, few chords, and high tempo, later used by UK punk, hardcore, and pop-punk.
body.zh:
Ramones 于 1974 年在纽约皇后区成立。早期 Sire 专辑——《Ramones》《Leave Home》《Rocket to Russia》——定型 Joey Ramone 的冷脸人声、Johnny Ramone 的严格下行扫弦、Dee Dee Ramone 的贝斯起拍，以及皮衣舞台形象。

《Blitzkrieg Bop》（1976）是最清楚的入口曲。影响体现在短歌、少和弦与高速度，后来被英国朋克、hardcore 与流行朋克沿用。

body.en:
Ramones write short songs with open chords and Johnny’s continuous downstrokes. CBGB-era New York sets the tempo range that many later US and UK punk bands use.

Few lead solos; high tempo; matching stage clothes.
body.zh:
Ramones 写短歌，用开放和弦与 Johnny 持续的下行扫弦。CBGB 时期纽约现场定下的速度区间，被后来许多美英朋克乐队沿用。

很少主音独奏；高速度；统一舞台着装。

body.en:
Tommy Ramone drums on the 1976–77 Sire albums, then moves into production. Marky joins in 1978 for Road to Ruin onward. Joey, Johnny, and Dee Dee stay the vocal–guitar–bass core through the classic years.

Lineup changes mark the drum chair more than a style break.
body.zh:
Tommy Ramone 鼓上 1976–77 年 Sire 专辑，后转制作。Marky 于 1978 年加入，自《Road to Ruin》起。Joey、Johnny、Dee Dee 在经典年仍是人声–吉他–贝斯核心。

阵容变化主要在鼓席，而非风格断裂。

body.en:
Dee Dee’s 1-2-3-4 count-in, Joey’s hey-ho chant, Johnny’s chord wall. Under three minutes. Cover bands and teaching lists still use it for US punk timing.

Judy Is a Punk sits beside it on the debut as another short track.
body.zh:
Dee Dee 的 1-2-3-4 起拍、Joey 的 hey-ho 口号、Johnny 的和弦墙。不到三分钟。翻唱乐队与教学列表仍用它说明美国朋克时值。

《Judy Is a Punk》在首专旁作另一首短歌。

body.en:
Joey: tall deadpan lead vocal. Johnny: Mosrite and downstroke method; few solos by choice. Dee Dee: bass, many early lyrics, and count-ins.

The playing method is fixed and repeated rather than jam-based.
body.zh:
Joey：高个、冷脸主唱。Johnny：Mosrite 与下行扫弦方法；原则上很少独奏。Dee Dee：贝斯、许多早期歌词与起拍。

演奏方法固定、反复，而非即兴为主。

body.en:
Joey’s “We're a happy family” refrain and Johnny’s “I don't play leads” line document image and technique. Read them against the Sire tracking speeds.

The quotes match the short-song method on record.
body.zh:
Joey 的「We're a happy family」口头禅与 Johnny 的「I don't play leads」记录形象与技术。对照 Sire 跟录速度阅读。

引语与唱片上的短歌方法一致。

title.zh: 英国朋克与 hardcore 时值

body.en:
Sex Pistols and The Clash take short-song energy into UK singles and albums. Later hardcore and pop-punk keep the count-in and downstroke approach.

The timing method outlasts the leather-jacket image.
body.zh:
Sex Pistols 与 The Clash 把短歌能量带进英国单曲与专辑。后来 hardcore 与流行朋克保留起拍与下行扫弦做法。

时值方法比皮衣形象延续得更久。

note.en: Debut through Rocket to Russia; early US punk timing reference.
note.zh: 首专至《Rocket to Russia》；早期美国朋克时值参照。

note.en: Road to Ruin onward; Dee Dee exits 1989; later bassists on tours.
note.zh: 自《Road to Ruin》起；Dee Dee 1989 离队；后期巡演由其他贝斯手接替。

note.en: Count-in and downstroke guitar as a US punk timing reference.
note.zh: 起拍与下行扫弦吉他，作为美国朋克时值参照。

note.en: Short songs, few chords, high tempo.
